prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-8.6s) - Introduction to calculus
title = Text("What is Calculus?", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("The Mathematics of Change", font_size=36)
subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(4.6)

# Segment 2 (8.6s-20.8s) - Change over time and accumulation
axes = Axes(
    x_range=[0, 4],
    y_range=[0, 4],
    axis_config={"include_tip": True}
).scale(0.8)
axes.to_edge(DOWN)

curve = axes.plot(lambda x: x**2, color=YELLOW)
moving_dot = always_redraw(
    lambda: Dot(axes.c2p(axes.x_range[1]/2, (axes.x_range[1]/2)**2), color=RED)
)

self.play(
    FadeOut(subtitle),
    Create(axes),
    Create(curve),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Create(moving_dot), run_time=2)
self.play(
    axes.x_range[1].animate.set_value(3),
    rate_func=there_and_back,
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(3.2)

# Segment 3 (20.8s-32.5s) - Instantaneous speed
tangent_line = always_redraw(
    lambda: axes.get_secant_slope_group(
        x=2,
        graph=curve,
        dx=0.01,
        secant_line_color=BLUE,
        secant_line_length=3
    )
)

instant_speed = Text("Instantaneous Speed", font_size=32)
instant_speed.next_to(tangent_line, UP)

self.play(
    Create(tangent_line),
    Write(instant_speed),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(8.7)

# Segment 4 (32.5s-46.1s) - Total distance and branches
area = axes.get_area(curve, x_range=[0, 2], color=GREEN, opacity=0.3)
total_dist = Text("Total Distance", font_size=32).next_to(area, RIGHT)

differential = Text("Differential Calculus", color=BLUE, font_size=36)
integral = Text("Integral Calculus", color=GREEN, font_size=36)
branches = VGroup(differential, integral).arrange(DOWN, buff=1)
branches.to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(
    FadeOut(instant_speed),
    Create(area),
    Write(total_dist),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Write(branches), run_time=3)
self.wait(7.7)

# Segment 5 (46.1s-59.3s) - Differential calculus
derivative = MathTex(r"\frac{d}{dx}f(x) = \lim_{h \to 0}\frac{f(x+h)-f(x)}{h}")
derivative.next_to(differential, DOWN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(total_dist),
    FadeOut(area),
    Write(derivative),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(
    Indicate(tangent_line, color=BLUE, scale_factor=1.2),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(8.2)

# Segment 6 (59.3s-76.6s) - Integral calculus
riemann_sum = axes.get_riemann_rectangles(
    curve,
    x_range=[0, 2],
    dx=0.2,
    color=GREEN,
    fill_opacity=0.5
)
integral_formula = MathTex(r"\int_a^b f(x)\,dx")
integral_formula.next_to(integral, DOWN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(derivative),
    Create(riemann_sum),
    Write(integral_formula),
    run_time=4
)
self.play(
    riemann_sum.animate.become(
        axes.get_riemann_rectangles(
            curve,
            x_range=[0, 2],
            dx=0.05,
            color=GREEN,
            fill_opacity=0.5
        )
    ),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(10.3)

# Segment 7 (76.6s-83.7s) - Summary
final_text = Text("The Language of Change", font_size=42)
final_text.move_to(ORIGIN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(axes),
    FadeOut(curve),
    FadeOut(tangent_line),
    FadeOut(riemann_sum),
    FadeOut(branches),
    FadeOut(integral_formula),
    FadeOut(title),
    Write(final_text),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(4.1)

prompt:

title = Text("The Derivative", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("A Core Concept of Calculus", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(4.3)

# Segment 2 (8.3s-16.8s) - Visualizing rate of change
axes = Axes(
    x_range=[-2, 2], 
    y_range=[-2, 4],
    axis_config={"include_tip": True}
).scale(0.8).shift(DOWN)
curve = axes.plot(lambda x: x**2, color=BLUE)

    FadeOut(subtitle),
    Create(axes),
    Create(curve),
    run_time=3
)

# Segment 3 (16.8s-29.8s) - Car speedometer analogy
speedometer = Circle(radius=1.5, color=WHITE)
speed_label = Text("60", font_size=36).move_to(speedometer.get_center())
mph = Text("MPH", font_size=24).next_to(speed_label, DOWN, buff=0.2)
speedo_group = VGroup(speedometer, speed_label, mph).to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(
    FadeOut(axes), 
    FadeOut(curve),
    Create(speedometer),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(Write(speed_label), Write(mph), run_time=2)
self.wait(8)

# Segment 4 (29.8s-40.2s) - Derivative at specific point
axes = Axes(
    x_range=[-2, 2],
    y_range=[-2, 4],
).scale(0.8).shift(DOWN)
curve = axes.plot(lambda x: x**2, color=BLUE)
point = Dot(axes.c2p(1, 1), color=YELLOW)
self.play(
    FadeOut(speedometer),
    FadeOut(speed_label),
    FadeOut(mph),
    Create(axes),
    Create(curve),

)

    graph=curve,
    dx=0.01,
    secant_line_color=RED,
    secant_line_length=4
)

# Segment 6 (51.7s-61.5s) - Zoomed view of tangent

).to_edge(LEFT)

    FadeOut(zoomed_display),

)

section_title: The Limit Definition of the Derivative Explained
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-8.9s) - Introduction
axes = Axes(
    x_range=[-2, 6],
    y_range=[-2, 6],
    axis_config={"include_tip": True}
).scale(0.8)
title = Text("The Limit Definition of the Derivative", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
self.play(Create(axes), Write(title), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.9)

# Segment 2 (8.9-19.4s) - Displaying derivative formula
derivative_formula = MathTex(
    r"f'(x) = \lim_{h \to 0} \frac{f(x+h) - f(x)}{h}"
).next_to(title, DOWN)
self.play(Write(derivative_formula), run_time=4)
self.wait(6.5)

# Segment 3 (19.4-29.2s) - Recalling secant lines
curve = axes.plot(lambda x: 0.25*x**2, x_range=[-2, 5], color=BLUE)
x_point = ValueTracker(1)
dx = ValueTracker(2)

def get_secant_line():
    x = x_point.get_value()
    h = dx.get_value()
    p1 = axes.c2p(x, 0.25*x**2)
    p2 = axes.c2p(x+h, 0.25*(x+h)**2)
    return Line(p1, p2, color=YELLOW)

secant = always_redraw(get_secant_line)
self.play(Create(curve), Create(secant), run_time=4)
self.wait(5.8)

# Segment 4 (29.2-38.5s) - Explaining secant line slope
slope_label = MathTex(r"\text{Slope} = \frac{\Delta y}{\Delta x}").next_to(secant, RIGHT)
self.play(Write(slope_label), run_time=3)
self.wait(6.3)

# Segment 5 (38.5-47.6s) - Animating point moving closer
self.play(dx.animate.set_value(1), run_time=4)
self.wait(5.1)

# Segment 6 (47.6-56.6s) - Secant becoming tangent
self.play(dx.animate.set_value(0.1), run_time=4)
self.wait(5)

# Segment 7 (56.6-65.5s) - Showing tangent line
tangent_slope = MathTex(r"f'(x)").next_to(secant, RIGHT)
self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(slope_label, tangent_slope),
    dx.animate.set_value(0.01),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(5.8)

# Segment 8 (65.5-76.4s) - Highlighting limit
limit_text = Text("As h → 0", font_size=24).next_to(derivative_formula, RIGHT)
self.play(
    Write(limit_text),
    Indicate(derivative_formula),
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(6.9)

# Segment 9 (76.4-86.2s) - Summary
final_box = SurroundingRectangle(derivative_formula, color=YELLOW)
self.play(Create(final_box), run_time=3)
self.wait(6.9)
